QuestInfo.name: [RED Preview] RED Gachapon Box
QuestInfo.0: Cassandra thinks that something has gone wrong with the upcoming RED celebration. Go see if you can help her out!
QuestInfo.1: Battle the RED monsters that appear throughout Maple World to find a key to the RED box Cassandra gave you. The box contains 1 random Gachapon Cash item, so don't miss out!
QuestInfo.2: That key you found will open the RED Gachapon Box! What could be inside?
